name: Kelompok umur atletik

reference_rules.dec31: Umur dihitung pada 31 Desember tahun lomba (World Athletics, PASI).
reference_rules.birthday_reached: Sudah berulang tahun ke-N pada hari lomba (Master).
reference_rules.championship: Tanggal acuan ditetapkan juknis kejuaraan (O2SN, POPDA/POPNAS, kejuaraan panitia).
reference_rules.born_on_or_after: Lahir pada tanggal batas atau sesudahnya (O2SN: `born_on_or_after`), ditambah syarat kelas.

groups.note: Printed as a birth-year limit; read as born in 2008 or later, as POPNAS (at most 18) and O2SN SMA 2026 (born on or after 2008-01-01) have it. Moves between regencies count only 6 months after the Dapodik registration, except 2026 SD/SMP graduates (V.4).

groups.label: POPNAS
groups.printed: Berusia maksimal 18 tahun, lahir 1 Januari dan sesudahnya sesuai tahun penyelenggaraan POPNAS
groups.ref: Peraturan Ketua Umum PP BAPOPSI Nomor 8 Tahun 2022, Bab V Pasal 14 ayat (1) huruf h, as quoted in Kemenpora Laporan Kinerja 2025 Sesdep 3 (PDF p. 40, printed p. 31)
groups.note: The quoted text does not say which year's 1 January counts; check each edition's Pedoman Umum. A third-party copy of the 2025 conditions (Scribd, not used) gives born 1 January 2008 or later.
